tools.description: Submit a legal document for AMARI verification. Returns immediately with a job ID; verification runs in the background and takes 5-20 minutes depending on document size. Use amari_status to retrieve results. IMPORTANT: Always send the complete, unabridged document text. Never summarize, condense, abbreviate, or truncate any section. Every clause, provision, and defined term must be included. If the document is too large to send in full, inform the user rather than sending a partial version. Partial documents will produce unreliable verification results.

account_id.description: Not needed when using the AMARI connector — the signed-in account is identified automatically. Never ask the user for this value. (Used only by direct REST API clients.)

constitution.description: The legal-domain constitution to verify against.

document.description: The full text of the legal document to verify (markdown or plain text). Maximum 100 pages.

source_documents.description: Source corpus documents providing authoritative evidence.

tools.name: amari_verify

tools.description: Check the status of AMARI verification jobs. Returns completed results or current progress. Call with no arguments (or list_recent: true) to see all recent verifications.

job_id.description: Optional. Check a specific job by ID (e.g., ver_ABC123).

limit.description: Maximum number of recent jobs to return.

list_recent.description: List the caller's recent verification jobs and their status. Default true.
